explanation: Necessary has one c and two s's: n-e-c-e-s-s-a-r-y.
Accommodation has double c and double m.
The rule is i before e except after c, so it is receive.
Separate has the letters s-e-p-a-r-a-t-e. Remember there is 'a rat' in separate.
Occurrence has double c and double r, and ends in -ence.
Embarrass has double r and double s.

text: Fill in the blank: I cannot ___ this heat any longer.
explanation: Bear means to put up with something. Bare means uncovered.

text: Fill in the blank: The school ___ welcomed the chief guest.
explanation: Principal is the head of a school. Principle means a rule or belief.

text: Fill in the blank: He never gives up his ___ of honesty.
explanation: Principle means a rule or belief. Principal means head, or main.

text: Fill in the blank: The garden had a sweet ___ of jasmine.
explanation: Scent means a smell. Sent is the past tense of send.

text: Fill in the blank: She bought pens, files and notebooks, all kinds of ___.
explanation: Stationery means writing materials. Stationary means not moving.

text: Fill in the blank: The train stood ___ at the platform.
explanation: Stationary means not moving. Stationery means writing materials.
